frames.name: Read me · Part 2 prototype
text: High-fidelity interactive prototype for CT120-3-3 Part 2. Focus area 4, Community & Connec
Platform: iOS (justify with your survey data)
• Built to Apple HIG: tab bar, large titles, bottom sheets, 44 pt minimum targets, Dynamic
• Team to fill in: share of iOS users among your interviewees / survey respondents, and wh
• Android would use Material 3 equivalents; the same components port across.
• Flow starting points: 1 · First launch, 2 · Returning user, 3 · AR Heritage Lens.
• Press Play (▶). Tap targets highlight if you click empty space.
• Discover: Home → search / Penang → experience → add to trip → Trips.
• Culture: phrase card or Etiquette tab → culture guide.
• AR: Lens tab or 'Open Heritage Lens' → tap a label → info sheet.
• Chosen: AR/VR integration concept, the AR Heritage Lens for George Town (screens 12–13).
• Also shown: voice (audio guides, voice search, pronunciation practice) and cross-device
• 3D showcase on Home: auto-rotate, prev/next, drag.
• Touch targets ≥ 44 × 44 pt; tab labels always visible.
• Selection shown by colour and a tick (1.4.1). Search fields keep a visible label (3.3.2)
• Reduce motion setting stops the 3D auto-rotation (2.3.3). Captions on all audio (1.2.1).
• Text size follows iOS Dynamic Type; layouts use auto layout so text can grow.
Content notes: travel times and climate are approximate (≈). Photos from Pexels (free lice

text: Choose the language Tourix speaks. You can change it any time in Me → Language.

frames.name: 03 Onboarding – Interests
text: What are you in the mood for?
Pick a few. We use them to order your Home feed. Nothing is shared.
Tip: tap a tile to select or clear it.

frames.name: 04 Home
text: Skyline views, night markets and neighbourhoods like Kampung Baru and Brickfields, linked
Shophouse lanes, clan jetties and hawker food. George Town is a UNESCO World Heritage Site
An archipelago of around 99 islands, with mangrove tours, quiet beaches and a cable car in
Dutch and Portuguese-era landmarks, Peranakan cooking and the Jonker Street weekend night
Cool air around 1,500 m up, tea estates, mossy forest trails and strawberry farms.
Mount Kinabalu, island marine parks and rainforest wildlife on the northern tip of Borneo.
“Excuse me, may I pass?” Handy in busy markets and on the five-foot way.

frames.name: 06 Destination – Penang
text: George Town · UNESCO World Heritage Site
Penang mixes Malay, Chinese, Indian and Peranakan heritage in a compact island. Spend a mo
Cover shoulders and knees at temples and mosques.
Hot and humid all year. Start walks before 10 am.
Rapid Penang buses and e-hailing cover the island. The heritage core is walkable.
Shophouse lanes, a clan temple and the jetties, with a kopi stop on the way.
Share a table, order from several stalls and pay each stall separately.
Point your camera at a shophouse to hear its story, in your language.

frames.name: 07 Experience – Heritage walk
text: Murals and restored shophouses. Start before 9 am, before the heat.
An ornate clan temple. There is an entry fee; check opening hours.
A clan village on stilts. People live here, so keep voices down.
Order kopi-o (black coffee with sugar) at a nearby kopitiam.
Take shoes off where you see others do.
Carry small notes for entry fees and snacks.

frames.name: 08 Culture guide – Phrases
text: Everyday phrases and etiquette, with audio and captions.
Say a phrase and Tourix gives feedback on your pronunciation.
Give and receive things with your right hand.
Point with your thumb rather than your index finger.
If you eat halal, look for the JAKIM halal logo.
Take shoes off before entering someone's home.

variables.d: Bunga raya red – saves, map pins

components.d: Tourix. Mark = a dotted trail ending at a destination. Dark theme for pandan surfaces, Light for mist/white.
Primary = kaya (one per view). Dark = secondary on light surfaces. Outline = tertiary. On Dark = secondary on pandan/photo. Hover: smart-animate 220ms ease-out. Min height 48px (touch target).
interactions: Type=On Dark, State=Default –ON_HOVER→ Type=On Dark, State=Hover

components.d: Filter chip. Hover → tint; click toggles Active (pandan). Used for region filters and experience categories.
Save to trip (heart). Click toggles. 40px visual inside a 44px hit area.
Destination card (320w). Swap the Photo fill per destination. Hover: photo zooms ~12%, shade deepens, card lifts with 3D shadow, arrow turns kaya. Save button toggles independently.
Featured experience card (384w, 3-up grid). Durations are typical visit lengths, not bookable slots. No prices or ratings shown by design.
Experience category tile (224×320). Icon + label carry meaning; photo is supportive. Hover: zoom + lift.
Search segment. Visible label (not placeholder-only) for WCAG 3.3.2. Click toggles Focused (kaya ring) in the prototype.
Benefit item for the pandan 'Why Tourix' band.
Card used inside the 3D Showcase ring. Coordinates are approximate city-centre values.

Hero 3D showcase. Six destination cards on a dotted orbit; depth faked with scale + vertical skew + opacity + blur. Prototype: auto-rotates every 3.2 s (After delay → Smart animate), Prev/Next buttons and dragging the front card also rotate. Fireflies nod to Kuala Selangor's kelip-kelip.
iOS status bar, 54pt. Dark = on pandan headers, Light = on mist screens, Clear = over photos and the AR camera.
iOS tab bar, 84pt incl. home indicator. Five destinations; the raised kaya Lens button opens the AR Heritage Lens (advanced feature). Targets ≥ 44pt; labels always visible (no icon-only navigation).
Onboarding interest tile. Tap toggles Selected (works in the prototype). Selection is shown by colour AND a tick, not colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
iOS-style switch, 51×31. Tap toggles in the prototype.
